_note: Human-readable tool list for the Server Manager. The code (tools/registry.py) binds each name to a handler + parameter schema + mutating/needs_project flags; the PROSE the model reads (description) and whether a tool is exposed (enabled) live HERE. Edit a description to change how the agent understands a tool; set enabled=false to hide one. Unknown names are ignored; a tool missing from this file keeps its Python default description and stays enabled.

link_project.description: Link the manager to an EXISTING webAgent checkout (a folder with run.py + app/). Switches to managed mode and adopts that repo's AI key. Use when the user already has a copy.

setup_launch_shortcut.description: Android/Termux only: write a Termux:Widget home-screen shortcut that launches the manager (~/.shortcuts/webagent.sh). Use as the FINAL onboarding step on Termux, then tell the user to install the Termux:Widget add-on and add the widget. Mutating.

check_install_readiness.description: Read-only preflight for a fresh install: OS, Python 3.11-3.12, git, internet, browser capability, and (if given) the target folder's space/emptiness. Run this first.

clone_repo.description: Clone the public webAgent repo into an empty/new target folder. Mutating. Recommended target: C:/webagent (Windows) or ~/webagent.

setup_environment.description: Build the install's virtual environment and install dependencies (and the headless browser unless unsupported). Slow (minutes). Mutating.

seed_config.description: Write the install's .env + provider.json (seeding the app's AI key) + db_connection.json (local SQLite). Mutating.

verify_install.description: Verify a fresh install imports cleanly and its local DB initialises. Mutating (creates the local database).

server_status.description: Is the local webAgent server up? Read-only.

server_start.description: Start the local webAgent server (detached) and verify health. Mutating.

server_stop.description: Stop the local webAgent server the manager started. Mutating.

server_restart.description: Restart the local webAgent server. Mutating.

server_logs.description: Tail the captured server log. Read-only.

check_updates.description: Check whether the linked checkout is behind the public repo (read-only). Offer to pull if so.

reset_app.description: Reset the linked webAgent install to a clean state (like reset_webagent.bat). ALWAYS wipes the userbase (local SQLite DB + sidecars + visuals/users/). Opt-in: clear_secrets (AI keys, OAuth/integration creds, scheduler/db-mode config), clear_users (local accounts + tokens), delete_env (.env), delete_agents (agent template JSONs — no fallback, zero agents after). Backs up to temp/reset-backup-<timestamp>/ unless backup=false; stops the server first. The DB, default admin/admin user, and agents regenerate on next start (if agent JSONs were kept). Mutating — confirm first.

app_login.description: Log into the RUNNING webAgent app over its HTTP API (the same API the web UI uses) and cache the session. Defaults to the local admin (admin/admin). Read-only side effect — just authentication. app_chat logs in on its own, so use this only to confirm credentials or surface the user_id.

app_list_agents.description: List the chat agents available to the logged-in app user (id + name) so you can target one with app_chat(agent_id=...). Read-only.

app_chat.description: Talk to the RUNNING app's agent AS the logged-in user (default admin/admin) and return its reply — a one-shot synchronous chat. For an ongoing live conversation in the connected panel, use webapp_send instead. The app auto-creates the session and uses the user's default agent unless you pass agent_id. Mutating: the app's agent may run tools and take real actions, so confirm intent first. Needs the server running.

webapp_send.description: Send a message to the CONNECTED web-app session (the active target set in the Connect panel) and return the app agent's reply. Use this when the WebAgent is unmuted and you're bridged to a session — it holds a real back-and-forth and the exchange streams into the shared transcript. Mutating; the app agent may run tools and take real actions.

webapp_status.description: Report the connected web-app target (agent + session) and live-stream health. Read-only.

app_list_sessions.description: List the logged-in app user's chat sessions (id, title, agent). Optionally filter by agent_id. Read-only.

app_get_settings.description: Read the app's settings (app-settings.json): access mode, presentation mode, run-watchdog tuning, etc. Read-only.

app_set_settings.description: Update one or more app settings (app-settings.json). Pass an object of the keys to change; the rest are preserved. Mutating.

app_get_auth_keys.description: Read the app's LLM provider config (the auth-key entry in the DB): provider, model, base URL; the API key is masked. Read-only.

app_set_auth_keys.description: Set the app's LLM auth key / provider / base URL / model (writes the DB auth_elements row + provider.json). Only the fields you pass change; the key is never echoed. Mutating — confirm with the user first.

read_diagnostics.description: Read the webAgent app's diagnostics — its flight-recorder of warnings/errors (with tracebacks), agent-loop problems, run outcomes and tool errors — straight from the checkout's local DB, so it works even when the server is DOWN. Filter by level (error/warning) or category (server/http/agent/...). Use it to diagnose a broken server.

monitor_status.description: Report the background watchdog's state: whether it's on, its interval, autonomy level, notify channels, thresholds, the current server health, and what it has reacted to recently. Read-only.

list_alarms.description: List the current alarm rules the watchdog evaluates — each rule's match (text/category/level), action, loudness, and channels. Read-only.

add_alarm.description: Add a standing alarm rule the watchdog evaluates every heartbeat. Match by 'contains' text and/or level/category; action is 'notify' or 'auto_restart'; loudness is 'every' / 'once' / 'digest'. Use this when the user says 'tell me every time X happens'. Mutating (edits alarms.json, picked up live).

remove_alarm.description: Remove an alarm rule by its id (from list_alarms). Use when the user says 'stop watching that'. Mutating.

set_monitor_config.description: Change the watchdog configuration: enable/disable, interval_seconds, autonomy (notify|auto_restart|self_heal), channels, auto_restart, and thresholds (error_rate_threshold, disk_percent_threshold, mem_percent_threshold, cpu_percent_threshold — a percent of 0 disables that resource check). Mutating (edits monitor.json, picked up live).

server_resources.description: Report server + host resources right now: host CPU, memory, disk free, and the webAgent server process's memory. Read-only. Use when the user asks how much CPU/RAM/disk things are using or suspects a memory leak / full disk.

notify_test.description: Send a test notification on the configured channel(s) so the user can confirm alerts reach them. Read-only side effect (just a notification).

web_search.description: Search the web via DuckDuckGo. Returns titles, URLs, and snippets (no API key required). Use to research errors, find current docs, check dependency versions, or look up solutions. Read-only.

read_source.description: Read a file region with line numbers.

write_source.description: Create or overwrite a file (auto-backup). Mutating.

edit_source.description: Exact unique find-and-replace in a file. Mutating.

delete_source.description: Delete a file or (recursive) directory; backed up. Mutating.

search_source.description: Case-insensitive text search across the tree.

read_directory.description: List a directory tree to a given depth.

run_command.description: Run a shell command in the project root. Mutating.

run_python.description: Run a Python snippet with the project on sys.path. Mutating.

git_tool.description: Structured git. Read-only: status, log, diff, show, branch, remote, ls-files, rev-parse, reflog, tag. Mutating: add, commit, push, pull, fetch, reset, checkout, restore, switch, merge, rebase, cherry-pick, revert, stash apply/pop/drop. Never force-push.

resolve_conflict.description: Resolve merge conflicts in a file by keeping one side. Mutating.

self_status.description: Report how THIS manager is running (source checkout vs frozen exe), its version/build, where its code lives, and whether a newer version is available upstream. Read-only.

self_update.description: Update the manager's OWN code. Always backs up first (timestamped): source mode pulls the repo (fast-forward only); a frozen exe rebuilds itself from fresh source and stages the new exe. Set restart=true to apply immediately (closes + relaunches the manager). Mutating.

self_restart.description: Close and relaunch the manager — applies a staged exe swap (frozen) or reloads just-pulled source. Mutating.
